verdict.rationale: Docs show a full API reference (endpoint pages like get/post/patch webhook) and a Postman Collection plus sandbox for testing requests, which supports runnable examples, but there is no evidence of an in-page interactive 'try it' console or OpenAPI spec (probe for openapi.json returned 404s across all paths). Missing for 10: confirmed interactive/embedded API console, OpenAPI/Swagger spec availability, and independent corroboration of runnable in-browser examples.
